title: Hic iocundus sumit mundus (Du Fay)
desc: Guillaume Du Fay, Hic iocundus sumit mundus. 3 voices (Cantus, Contratenor, Tenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Duf3080); encoded by Alejandro Planchart. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
